fr.title: Graphique
fr.description: Trace des séries dans le temps en barres ou en ligne, la valeur sous le doigt, partage un tout en blocs, en barre fine, en anneau ou en barres empilées, trace une mini-courbe, et donne les chiffres en tableau.
notFor: avancement d'une tâche vers un but : utiliser un indicateur de progression (progress)
un chiffre clé seul avec sa variation : utiliser une carte de chiffre (stat-card)
choisir un jour dans une grille de dates : utiliser un calendrier (calendar)

changelog: New: charts of the shares of a whole, told apart by lightness alone rather than hue (`FlCategoryFill`: the theme's primary color, `selected`, then five lighter shades of it), with their legend (`FlCategoryLegend`, `FlCategoryDot`). `FlShareBar` draws the shares as a thin line of rounded pills, each as wide as its share; with `selected`, the chosen one in `selected` and the others in `selectedSoft`, as the list beside it says which; `remaining` ends it with what is left of a budget. `FlShareBlocks` draws them as blocks as wide as their share, a tap choosing one, with a dashed block for what is left; `FlRingChart` draws them as a ring with the total or the chosen share in its hole, the chosen slice in `selected` and the others in `selectedSoft`; `FlStackedBars` stacks each bar of a period by category; `FlSparkline` is a small line beside a figure. `FlChart.bar` takes `maxBarWidth`, for a few bars on a wide card, and `restColor`, for the bars a selection leaves aside; `tooltipLabel: false` writes the values alone in the tooltip, when the time axis already names the point. The tooltip's lines are centered.
